content: Theia IDE (formerly 'Theia Blueprint') is the official reference template for a branded desktop product: branding lives in a dedicated product extension (about dialog, welcome/getting-started widget, preferences dir), electron packaging via electron-builder (yarn electron package/deploy), afterPack signing script. Gotcha: AppImage/Linux packaging doesn't support electron-builder's icon fallback the same way other targets do, needs explicit handling. Downloaded VS Code .vsix plugins are not auto-cleaned from applications/electron/plugins when extensions change.
